library.name: RockSolid
library.description: Styled SolidJS components with Tailwind CSS, theme customization, and RTL layout variants.

pricing.summary: The component source is free under the MIT license.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A styled button with color, variant, size, and native interaction props.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal dialog composed with title, content, and action components.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Tab lists and panels with controlled state, orientation, and RTL layout styles.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: A vertically stacked set of interactive sections that can be expanded and collapsed.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Alert component displays important information, status updates, warnings, or errors to users.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Avatar component displays a user's profile image or entity with an image.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Badge component displays a small label or indicator attached to another element.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: Breadcrumbs displays a navigation hierarchy that helps users understand their current location within an application.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: Groups related buttons together into a single, connected control.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Card component displays related content and actions in a flexible, composable container.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Checkbox component allows users to select or deselect an option.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: Chip component displays a compact label with optional avatars, icons, delete actions, and disabled state.

components.name: Divider
components.summary: Divider component separates content into distinct sections with a horizontal or vertical line.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: A compact button designed for actions represented by an icon.

components.name: Input
components.summary: A text input component for collecting and editing user-entered values.

components.name: Label
components.summary: A text label that identifies and describes a form control.

components.name: Link
components.summary: Link component displays a navigational link that can be styled with semantic colors, underlines, and truncation.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: A visual indicator that shows the completion or progress of a task.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: A selectable control for choosing one option from a set of mutually exclusive choices.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Select component allows users to choose one option from a list of available values.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Skeleton component displays a placeholder shape while content is loading.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Spinner component displays a loading indicator while content or an action is in progress.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: A control that allows users to toggle an option between on and off states.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Table component displays structured data in rows and columns.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Textarea component enables users to enter and edit multi-line text.

components.name: Typography
components.summary: Typography component displays text with consistent styles, colors, alignment, and semantic elements.
